_note: The signature balance-sheet case: OCR misread one digit of 비유동자산 (39,431,995 -> 39,431,895). The wrong figure IS in the extracted text, so verbatim grounding passes and only 자산총계 = 유동 + 비유동 catches it. 자산총계 itself survives because 대차평형 independently corroborates it.
